summary: Configured node1 to America/Toronto and verified persistence after one safe reboot. Boot ID changed from b4b69219-1353-4702-80fa-ad8a35f37714 to a81aa458-e403-43a2-8165-8b9eae8e6915. An unrelated ssh.service failure existed both before and after the change; D-Bus, journald, and timezone functionality are healthy.
actions_performed: Verified the systemd timezone value and /etc/localtime zoneinfo target.
Restarted node1 exactly once using a scheduled native systemd reboot.
Verified the changed boot identity and recovered timezone configuration.
Confirmed D-Bus and journald are active after restart.

evidence.summary: The change succeeded; direct checks before and after reboot showed Timezone=America/Toronto and /etc/localtime targeting /usr/share/zoneinfo/America/Toronto.
Captured the healthy timezone baseline and old boot ID, acknowledged one scheduled reboot, proved the boot ID changed, and verified the timezone plus core services recovered.
ssh.service was already failed before the task and remained failed afterward; it was not modified.
